name: code-block
title: CodeBlock
description: Read-only, highlighted code in editor.* and syntax.* colours, with line numbers, highlighted lines, a title bar and copy; virtualized above 1,000 lines.

manifest.name: code-block
manifest.title: CodeBlock
manifest.description: Read-only, highlighted code in editor.* and syntax.* colours, with line numbers, highlighted lines, a title bar and copy; virtualized above 1,000 lines.
manifest.usage: Use CodeBlock to show code the user reads or copies but does not edit: a statement in the history, a table's DDL, a plugin manifest, diagnostics. language highlights sql (PostgreSQL) or json with the same grammars and colours as CodeInput and SqlEditor; highlightLines marks an error's line; title adds a bar (copy sits there). Give it a height or max-h-* class to scroll. Above virtualizeAfter (1,000) lines only the lines in view are rendered and lines stay on one line. For a single token in a sentence use Code; to edit, SqlEditor or CodeInput; for a JSON value to explore, JsonViewer.

props.name: appearance
props.description: editor: a framed card in the editor's colours with a title bar and line numbers; inset: a quiet block on the inset fill (a payload in a detail pane), without title bar or line numbers unless asked.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Line numbers in a gutter; on for more than one line in the editor appearance.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: 1-based line numbers to highlight in editor.line-highlight.

props.name: title
props.description: A title bar above the code.

props.name: copyable
props.description: A copy button in the title bar.

props.name: marks
props.description: Ranges of the text to mark, such as a find bar's matches: the offsets where each starts (ascending, not overlapping) and their common length.

props.name: currentMark
props.description: The index in marks of the current match: marked more strongly, and scrolled into view when it changes.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the code region; defaults to a string title or "Code".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the frame; give it a height to scroll.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame in editor.bg; data-slot="code-block", data-language, data-virtual.

slots.name: gutter
slots.description: The line number in editor.gutter, aria-hidden, sticky; data-slot="code-block-gutter".

props.code:
select id, 'open', 42, true from orders where total > 0; -- note

states.name: wrap
states.description: Lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the region: an inset ring of ring.width in color.ring.

accessibility: The code is in <pre><code> inside a focusable role="region" named by aria-label or the title, so keyboard users can scroll it with the arrow keys.
Line numbers are aria-hidden, so screen readers read the code, not the numbers.
The copy button is an IconButton ("Copy code", then "Copied"), and a polite status announces "Copied to the clipboard".
Virtualized blocks keep only the lines in view in the DOM; screen readers read those, and Copy gives the whole text.
Colours are the editor.* and syntax.* roles, which the token build checks for contrast on editor.bg.
